note: Twenty queries over the vendored llm-wiki-manager vault, written by reading the wiki: for each, the pages a person with that task would want open. Paths are relative to --wiki, so the same harness measures any wiki against its own gold set. A page that is useful and unlisted costs precision, so precision is a lower bound and no label here says a page is useless. Each query also carries a `category`, which is how eval-agent groups its results; the older `eval` binary ignores it.
